title: The Autocorrelation Blind Spot: Why 42% of Turn-Level Findings in LLM Conversation Analysis May Be Spurious
reasoning: The paper is a methodological study focusing on the statistical validity (specifically autocorrelation) of metrics used in multi-turn LLM conversation analysis. While it uses manipulation detection and safety metrics as examples for its statistical correction framework, it does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or reasoning as its primary subject matter.
